description:
One product of an addStoreProducts call, as the admin described it.
Types only, no limits: the route checks them (_validProduct), so a
refusal names the product's position and never quotes the value.

inventory.description: Units in stock, free to sell; required unless hasInventory is false
inventory.title: Inventory

hasInventory.description: Decides whether this item has inventory, so when a customer orders it gets lessened. False: customers can order unlimited units (inventory is then 0 and never moves)
hasInventory.title: Hasinventory
